# `/non-employee-records` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /non-employee-records/v1

`createNonEmployeeRecordV1` — Create non-employee record

This request will create a non-employee record. Requires role context of `idn:nesr:create`

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Body (application/json): nonemployeerequestbody
- Returns 200: nonemployeerecord

### GET /non-employee-records/v1

`listNonEmployeeRecordsV1` — List non-employee records

This gets a list of non-employee records. There are two contextual uses for this endpoint: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:read`, in which case they can get a list of all of the non-employees. 2. The user is an account manager, in which case they can get a list of the non-employees that they manage.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, accountName, sourceId, manager, firstName, lastName, email, phone, startDate, endDate, created, modified — e.g. `accountName,sourceId`
  - `filters` (query) — fields: sourceId: eq — e.g. `sourceId eq "2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"`
- Returns 200: array of nonemployeerecord

### GET /non-employee-records/v1/{id}

`getNonEmployeeRecordV1` — Get a non-employee record

This gets a non-employee record. Requires role context of `idn:nesr:read`

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-Employee record id (UUID)
- Returns 200: nonemployeerecord

### PUT /non-employee-records/v1/{id}

`updateNonEmployeeRecordV1` — Update non-employee record

This request will update a non-employee record. There are two contextual uses for this endpoint: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:update`, in which case they update all available fields. 2. The user is owner of the source, in this case they can only update the end date.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-employee record id (UUID)
- Body (application/json): nonemployeerequestbody
- Returns 200: nonemployeerecord

### PATCH /non-employee-records/v1/{id}

`patchNonEmployeeRecordV1` — Patch non-employee record

This request will patch a non-employee record. There are two contextual uses for this endpoint: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:update`, in which case they update all available fields. 2. The user is owner of the source, in this case they can only update the end date.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-employee record id (UUID)
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: nonemployeerecord

### DELETE /non-employee-records/v1/{id}

`deleteNonEmployeeRecordV1` — Delete non-employee record

This request will delete a non-employee record. Requires role context of `idn:nesr:delete`

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-Employee record id (UUID)
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /non-employee-records/v1/bulk-delete

`deleteNonEmployeeRecordsInBulkV1` — Delete multiple non-employee records

This request will delete multiple non-employee records based on the non-employee ids provided. Requires role context of `idn:nesr:delete`

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 204: no body
